What do 50 million drawings look like?
Over 15 million players have contributed millions of drawings playing Quick Draw.
These doodles are a unique data set that can help developers train new neural networks,
help researchers see patterns in how people around the world draw, and help artists
create things we haven't begun to think of. That's why we're open-sourcing this, for
anyone to play with.
